999008199.text:
ちゃんと無事、帰って来られましたね。
この瞬間は、いつもホッとします

localizations.en: We all made it back safe and sound. It's such a relief.

999008199.text:
行きに比べたら、随分楽な船旅だったわね。
ま、頂獣がいないんだから当然だけど

localizations.en: The return voyage was much smoother than our departure. That's probably to be expected without an Apexi in the way.

999008199.text:
頂獣を退け、無数島群域への海路を開く。
当面の目的は達成できたことになりますわ

localizations.en: I'd say we've accomplished our immediate objectives by vanquishing the Apexi and opening a sea route to the Infinite Island Chain.

999008199.text:
しばらくぶりの王都ですけど、
特に変わったところはないみたいですね

localizations.en: It's been a while since we've been back in the capital, but it doesn't look like much has changed.

999008199.text:
王は迅速に動くもの。休憩したいところですが、
まずは報告を済ませましょう

localizations.en: A queen must act with haste. Though I'd love nothing more than to rest, we should deliver our report first.

999008199.text:
北西の海域に生息していた頂獣クヴァレルガは
討伐。海路の安全は確保されました

localizations.en: The Apexi Kvarelga that inhabited the northwestern waters has been eliminated. The sea route is now secure.

999008199.text:
ノーヴァ神聖国からの使節も数名
同行していますの

localizations.en: We also have several envoys from Nova accompanying us.

999008199.text:
礼儀正しい真面目な方々です。
今は船内で待機していただいておりますわ

localizations.en: They're quite polite and diligent. They're currently waiting aboard the ship.

999008199.text: そうか、ノーヴァ神聖国と友好を結べたか

localizations.en: I see. So we've established friendly relations with Nova.

999008199.text:
やるな、リヒャルト。
ここからの細かいやりとりは、私の仕事だな

localizations.en: Well done, Richard. I'll handle the diplomatic intricacies from here.

999008199.text: 使節の方々は王宮でもてなそう。案内を頼む

localizations.en: We shall receive the envoys at the palace. Please escort them there.

999008199.text: はっ。承知しました！

リヒャルトは向こうに残っているのだな。
元気にしているだろうか

localizations.en: It seems that Richard stayed behind. I wonder how he's doing.

999008199.text:
あ、はい。レスナさんたちと一緒に、
ノーヴァ神聖国周辺の調査をするとかで

localizations.en: Oh, yes. He's staying with Resna and the others to investigate the surrounding lands.

999008199.text:
そうか。ユナもいるし大丈夫だろう。
異国の地でも彼女に注意される弟の姿が目に浮かぶ

localizations.en: I see. With Juna there, I'm sure he'll be alright. Though I can already picture my brother being lectured by her in a foreign land.

999008199.text: あはは……はい
さて、わたしたちはどうしましょう？

localizations.en: So, what should we do now?

999008199.text: とりあえずどこかでゆっくり休みたいわね

localizations.en: I'd love to find somewhere to relax for a while.

999008199.text:
それなら、「星の繭」に行きませんこと？
わたくし、あのパイの味が恋しいですわ

localizations.en: In that case, why don't we visit the Star's Cocoon? I've been craving their pie.

999008199.text: いいですね！　ぜひ行きましょう！
